{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify the actual column names
columns = df.columns.tolist()
print('Actual column names:', columns)

# Check 'status' column values to confirm 'completed' is the only completion status
print('\nUnique values in status:', df['status'].unique())

# Check for any test order indicator
print('\nColumn names containing "test":', df.columns[df.columns.str.contains("test", case=False, na=False)])

# Check revenue column format
print('\nFirst 5 revenue values:', df['revenue'].head())

# Attempt to convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
# Remove dollar sign and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if conversion worked
print('\nFirst 5 cleaned revenue values:', df['revenue_clean'].head())"}
